Title: Info
Text:
The listbox rows can now are different height individually!

There are tow ways to setup the height of each row:

1°) Using the new commands "LISTBOX SET ROW HEIGHT" and "LISTBOX Get row height".

2°) Using a height control array

Both will have the same visual effect, but using an array will be more efficient if yo have to change the height of many rows.


Note: This feature is available if the database is running with active 4D View Pro License.

Title: Using array
Text:
An array can be associated to the listbox.
This array will define the height or each row.
The height will be in "lines" or in "pixels" according to the default unit of the rows.

Note: In this HDI, the heights are in pixels!

Title: Using Commands
Text:
The commands LISTBOX SET ROW HEIGHT and LISTBOX Get row height allow to set and get the height of each row individually.

Note: In this HDI, the heights are in pixels!
